headline: Ronald G. Crystal: honoured with the Weill Award
dek: A WCM Newsroom item describes Dr Ronald G. Crystal as a gene therapy pioneer and reports that he has been honoured with the Weill Award.
body:
Dr Ronald G. Crystal has been honoured with the Weill Award, according to a WCM Newsroom item published on 13 November 2026.

The item describes him as a "gene therapy pioneer". The text available for this report does not say what the award recognises, who presented it, or when it was given.
key_quote: Gene Therapy Pioneer Dr. Ronald G. Crystal Honored with Weill Award

source.title: Gene Therapy Pioneer Dr. Ronald G. Crystal Honored with Weill Award
